hints.title: Prime Factor Overlap
hints.text: Two products are coprime if and only if they share no common prime factor.

hints.title: Prime Factor Spans
hints.text: For each distinct prime factor p, find its first occurrence index and last occurrence index. The interval [first, last] cannot be separated across the split boundary.

hints.title: Running Boundary Coverage
hints.text: Track the maximum last occurrence index among all prime factors encountered so far. When the index i satisfies max_last <= i for i < n - 1, a valid split is found.

hints.title: Prime Span Coverage Implementation

complexity.notes: Trial division factorizes each number in O(sqrt(max_v)); prefix scan takes O(n * log(max_v)).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Calculating prefix and suffix products directly overflows standard integers with thousands of digits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(distinct_primes) hash table storing the last index for each prime factor.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reformulates coprimality into disjoint prime occurrence spans.
